p: TeSlaa had one catch but contributed heavily as a blocker.
Valued for blocking and effort, but modest target volume limits his fantasy value for now.
just blocking his tail off, um, doing his part.
TeSlaa's speed will keep being used on deep outs and daggers, and defenses will have to account for him.
He is emerging as a deep threat and could see more targets if he keeps winning downfield.
Tesla did a hell of a job.
